name: med-research-mcp
description: Evidence-graded scientific literature search for AI agents — multi-database (PubMed, Europe PMC, ChinaRXiv, RussiaRXiv), built for biohacking, supplementation, and clinical decision support.

ncbiEmail.title: NCBI contact email
ncbiEmail.description: NCBI asks for a contact email on every E-utilities request. Recommended to avoid throttling.

ncbiApiKey.title: NCBI API key (optional)
ncbiApiKey.description: Raises the NCBI rate limit from 3 to 10 requests/second. Leave blank if you don't have one.

unpaywallEmail.title: Unpaywall contact email (optional)
unpaywallEmail.description: Used by literature_fulltext to query Unpaywall for open-access copies. Unpaywall asks for a contact email on every request. Falls back to the NCBI email if left blank.

proxyPrefix.title: Institutional proxy prefix (optional)
proxyPrefix.description: EZproxy-style DOI prefix for off-campus access, e.g. https://doi-org.ezproxy.uni-kiel.de — literature_fulltext prepends it to the DOI. Requires an existing proxy session on the machine.
